name: CTE UPDATE target
sql: WITH articles AS (SELECT 1) UPDATE articles SET title='changed'

name: CTE INSERT target
sql: WITH articles AS (SELECT 1) INSERT INTO articles(id,title) VALUES(2,'created')

name: CTE DELETE target
sql: WITH articles AS (SELECT 1) DELETE FROM articles WHERE id=2

name: qualified CTE write control
sql: WITH articles AS (SELECT 1) UPDATE public.articles SET title='changed'

name: CTE read control
sql: WITH articles AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM articles

name: SELECT INTO target
sql: SELECT id INTO receipts_copy FROM articles

name: settings INSERT SELECT misattribution
sql: INSERT INTO settings(key,value) SELECT 'backup.last','{}'::jsonb FROM settings WHERE key='models.chat'

name: settings identifier evidence misattribution
sql: SELECT s.* FROM settings s JOIN (VALUES('backup.last')) AS models(chat) ON s.key=§0§

name: quoted SELECT expression is not DELETE
search path modifier
sql: SET search_path TO private; SELECT * FROM articles

name: upsert key rewrite cannot retain insert ownership
sql: INSERT INTO settings(key,value) VALUES ('models.chat','{}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET key='backup.last' RETURNING key

name: ordinary value upsert control
sql: INSERT INTO settings(key,value) VALUES ('models.chat','{}'::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value RETURNING key

name: ORDER equality is not a row restriction

name: outer join ON equality is not a row restriction
